subject.title: Feature: Per-spawn tool restrictions for sub-agents

question: Should OpenClaw accept `toolsAllow` as the V1 per-spawn `sessions_spawn` restriction API, or require an allow/deny object before this issue can close?
rationale: Current main does not implement the requested security boundary, and the active PR chooses a narrower API shape than the issue's allow/deny proposal; automation cannot decide the long-term public contract or security semantics.

options.title: Accept `toolsAllow` V1
options.body: Land the active PR after review and treat deny-style composition as follow-up work only if users still need it.

options.title: Require allow/deny now
options.body: Ask the active PR to reshape the public API before merge so this issue's deny-wins semantics are covered in the first shipped contract.

options.title: Pause core API
options.body: Keep the issue open but hold implementation until maintainers define a broader session/tool-policy model across spawn, routes, and API requests.

recommendation.title: Accept `toolsAllow` V1
recommendation.body: Land the active PR after review and treat deny-style composition as follow-up work only if users still need it.

likelyOwner.reason: Their open PR is the current concrete implementation path that maintainers need to accept or reshape.
